link_preview.title: Bass OS (A14) AIO - Install and setup in under 10 minutes
link_preview.description_html:
This video shows us converting an old SAM4S Point of Sale device (2015) from Windows to Android 14 in under 10 minutes.
I also discuss some of the options available in these AIO builds of Bass OS.
